scope: 480prompt training/validation collection to distinguish small-sample predictor failure from absence of learnable allocation signal. No test set evaluated and no speed claim.
source: v77 profiling pool only; excludes all v73 prompts by whitespace-normalized exact text; historical timing reuse disclosed.
dtype: HF FP32 target/draft, so serving must later independently establish BF16 transfer and exact output checks.
gates: Serialized checkpoint and shared weights exact
Cached vs full target greedy argmax exact; abort on any mismatch
Independent first-anchor target verification at every width
Future-poison first-anchor draft and feature invariance

controls: frozen context predictor plus request-specific shrunk residual feedback
prespecified_followup.residual_grid: No update, or alpha in [.5,1], prior count in [1,4], decay in [.5,1]; nested selection on training prompts only. Validation used once for gate, not parameter search.
prespecified_followup.allocator: DP budget<=3*n, groups of16prompts at each offset; same groups every method; token reward only.
prespecified_followup.gate: Validation reward >=10% over fixed3 and improves over frozen context baseline. Failure stops this candidate; success requires fresh heldout labels and end-to-end throughput >=10% vs tuned native and context baseline including all overhead.
prespecified_followup.novelty: General context prediction/feedback/packing already prior art (ForeSpark/TurboSpec). Combined method novelty remains to be established; do not claim a new paradigm.
